difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: with the three differential sheaves Omega_1, Omega_2 and Omega_3 of the triple category defined from the three-maps notation, there is a canonical short exact sequence 0 -> g_1^{-1}Omega_1 tensor_C -> g_2^{-1}Omega_2 -> g_3^{-1}Omega_3 -> 0 of sheaves of C-modules on C_{C/B/A} (source lines 1389-1410). The proof evaluates everything on a variable object U = (P -> B, Q -> C): it writes down the split short exact sequence of differentials for P -> Q over A, tensors it with C over Q, and then identifies the three terms with the values of the three sheaves appearing in the statement, using the identification of Omega_{Q/P} tensor C with Omega_{Q tensor_P B / B} tensor C for the third term.
